answer: Make new identities thaw like a glacier: each account starts with a locked stake that unlocks slowly over 30 days, and it only earns once three older peers, chosen at random by the ledger, attest its work. A raven-eyed audit samples attestations; if a vouched account is caught as a sock puppet, the vouchers lose part of their stake. Spinning up 1,000 fakes then costs 1,000 frozen stakes plus burned reputation, which makes sybils as costly as saffron.
